subject: Natural Sciences
topic: Energy and the national electricity grid

items.q: What energy change happens in a coal power station?
items.qAf: Watter energieverandering vind in ’n steenkool-kragstasie plaas?
items.explain: Burning coal releases chemical energy as heat, which boils water. The steam turns a turbine that drives a generator.
items.explainAf: Die brand van steenkool stel chemiese energie as hitte vry, wat water kook. Die stoom draai ’n turbine wat ’n generator aandryf.

items.q: Why is electricity sent at very high voltage along power lines?
items.qAf: Waarom word elektrisiteit teen baie hoë spanning langs kragdrade gestuur?
options: High voltage makes the current bigger
It reduces energy lost as heat in the wires
It stops the current from flowing
optionsAf: Hoë spanning maak die stroom groter
Dit verminder energie wat as hitte in die drade verlore gaan
Dit keer dat die stroom vloei
items.explain: For the same power, a higher voltage means a smaller current, so less energy is lost as heat in the cables.
items.explainAf: Vir dieselfde krag beteken ’n hoër spanning ’n kleiner stroom, so minder energie gaan as hitte in die kabels verlore.

items.q: Which is a renewable energy source?
items.explain: Solar energy comes from the sun and will not run out, unlike coal and gas.
items.explainAf: Sonenergie kom van die son af en raak nie op nie, anders as steenkool en gas.

items.q: What kind of current is the supply in our homes?
items.qAf: Watter soort stroom is die toevoer in ons huise?
items.explain: Mains electricity is alternating current, meaning the direction of the current changes regularly.
items.explainAf: Netstroom is wisselstroom, wat beteken die rigting van die stroom verander gereeld.

items.q: A fuse or circuit breaker in a home is there to:
items.qAf: Waarvoor is ’n sekering of stroombreker in ’n huis?
options: Cut the power if the current gets too big
optionsAf: Sny die krag af as die stroom te groot word
items.explain: A fuse melts or a breaker trips when the current is too large, which prevents overheating and fires.
items.explainAf: ŉ Sekering smelt of ’n breker val wanneer die stroom te groot is, wat oorverhitting en brande voorkom.

items.q: Why are household appliances wired in parallel rather than in series?
items.qAf: Waarom is huistoestelle parallel gedraad eerder as in reeks?
options: Each appliance can be switched on separately and gets the full voltage
optionsAf: Elke toestel kan apart aangeskakel word en kry die volle spanning
Parallelle bedrading berg meer lading op
items.explain: In parallel each appliance has its own branch at full voltage, so one can be switched off without affecting the others.
items.explainAf: In parallel het elke toestel sy eie tak teen volle spanning, so een kan afgeskakel word sonder dat die ander geraak word.
